paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
coupling_convention: CG/fa in GeV^-1 (axion-gluon coupling), NOT d_n in e*cm
notes: Paper (nEDM, Abel et al. 2017) reports two limits from Fig. 4: axion-gluon coupling CG/fa (GeV^-1) via oscillating neutron EDM, and axion-nucleon coupling CN/fa (GeV^-1) via axion-wind effect. The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is approximately right in spirit (oscillating EDM search), but the actual plotted y-axis is CG/fa in GeV^-1, NOT d_n in e*cm — so the convention differs from standard AxionEDM (e*cm). Peak sensitivity CG/fa ~ 1e21 GeV (i.e. CG/fa ~ 1e-21 GeV^-1) for ma<1e-23 eV. The axion-nucleon part (AxionNeutron) reaches fa/CN ~ 4e5 GeV for 1e-19 to 1e-17 eV. Data points estimated from Fig. 4 (plots only, no table); values are rough order-of-magnitude reads of the exclusion contour.
